items.title: I got two email invitations from friends. Is this a phishing scam — or am I suddenly popular?
items.content: “I was surprised — and flattered — to find myself on the guest list.”

items.title: The S&P 500 just hit a new high. ‘Big Short’ investor Michael Burry thinks it could bring a 1987-style fall.
items.content: The famed investor says watch out after that S&P 500 surge on Tuesday. He’s not budging from some bearish tech views.

items.title: 3 reasons AMD’s stock is falling in the face of its latest earnings report
items.content: Analysts noted that the company delivered muted upside with its results, underwhelmed some investors with its margin outlook and was simply up against high expectations.

items.title: Lilly’s revenue soars 48%, driven by demand for its GLP-1s
items.content: Lilly’s sales were driven by higher-than-expected demand for Mounjaro and Zepbound, its GLP-1 drugs for Type 2 diabetes and weight loss.

items.title: ADP says businesses added the fewest new jobs in six months. A summer slowdown in hiring?
items.content: ADP said U.S. businesses created just 44,000 new jobs in July — the smallest increase in six months — in another sign of a sluggish labor market in which hiring is unusually soft.

items.title: Should wealthier Americans forgo their Social Security benefits as a charitable gesture?
items.content: A reader writes: “I will likely be in a position to decline my benefits.”

items.title: The government owns some of the same stocks you do. Here’s why that is risky.
items.content: Recent deals to have the U.S. take a stake in companies mark something new: Government ownership used as a standing industrial-policy tool rather than an emergency backstop.

items.title: Uber profit narrowly beat forecasts as trips across its platform surge
items.content: Uber Technologies shares fell early Wednesday, despite the ride-hailing company registering earnings a tad above Wall Street estimates in the second quarter as a jump in passengers and deliveries boosted revenue.

items.title: ‘I’m easing into retirement’: I’m getting an $80,000 pension payout. Where can I invest it safely?
items.content: “I expect to have several years before I take distributions from my 401(k) account.”

items.title: Walt Disney’s stock climbs as company cites ‘Toy Story 5’ for earnings growth
items.content: Walt Disney’s stock, which has been struggling all year, rallied on Wednesday as the entertainment giant reported surprisingly strong earnings.
